verdict.rationale: Mastra ships official TypeScript SDK packages (@mastra/core, @mastra/mcp-docs-server, etc.) with documented APIs for agents, tools, workflows, memory, and streaming, letting AI-native developers build directly against first-party SDKs rather than reverse-engineered wrappers. missing for 10: SDKs beyond TypeScript/Node (e.g., Python/Go clients), independent third-party verification of SDK stability/versioning, and detailed API reference/versioning docs beyond guide-level snippets.
